Symptom: Element dP rising to 0.22 bar within 5 days of scrubber media change
Root Cause: Element loaded with unscreened scrubber media fines
Why Chain: Why high dP? Element loaded with black granules > Why granules? Fines from new scrubber charge > Why fines? New media not screened before start-up
Resolution: Changed over to standby housing, replaced element, flushed housing
Preventive Action: Screen / blow down new media before charging; run standby element for first week

Symptom: Gas outlet 7 °C in the afternoon, purity dipping to 94.5%
Root Cause: Condenser filter matted with straw dust
Why Chain: Why warm outlet? Poor condenser heat rejection > Why? Filter matted with dust > Why? Harvest bale handling upwind, weekly cleaning not enough
Resolution: Isolated fan, cleaned filter and coil, outlet back to 3.4 °C
Preventive Action: Daily condenser filter cleaning in harvest season; intake pre-filter screen

Symptom: Outlet H2S climbing to 45 ppm two months before planned change-out
Root Cause: Raw-gas H2S doubled after press-mud share increased
Why Chain: Why early breakthrough? Media used up faster > Why? Inlet H2S rose from 1500 to 3200 ppm > Why? Press-mud share raised without BUU review
Resolution: Reduced press-mud share, restarted FeCl3 dosing, brought media change forward
Preventive Action: Sulfur impact check on feed recipe changes; daily sulfur-loading log

Symptom: Bypass valve found open and unlocked on morning round
Root Cause: Bypass opened for element change and left open over shift change
Why Chain: Why open? Not closed after element change > Why? Job ran across shift change > Why not caught? Handover sheet does not list open bypasses
Resolution: Closed and locked bypass, checked compressor suction strainers (clean), briefed both shifts
Preventive Action: Bypass register on handover sheet; limit switch with SCADA alarm

Symptom: Chiller dP high then water slug; membrane purity 93%
Root Cause: Exchanger iced after setpoint lowered to 0 °C
Why Chain: Why water slug? Ice melted in exchanger > Why ice? Setpoint at 0 °C > Why lowered? Operator chasing purity > Why possible? HMI allowed sub-zero setpoint
Resolution: Restored 3 °C setpoint, defrosted at reduced flow, drained separator, diverted product
Preventive Action: HMI setpoint clamped to 2–5 °C; setpoint changes logged; training

Symptom: Outlet H2S alarm 80 ppm; Dräger tube showed 5 ppm
Root Cause: Analyser sample line full of condensate and calibration overdue
Why Chain: Why false alarm? Analyser reading wrong > Why? Wet sample line and drifted cell > Why? Sample conditioning and calibration not in PM
Resolution: Drained sample line, calibrated with span gas, fitted condensate pot
Preventive Action: Monthly span calibration; weekly sample-line drain on rounds

Symptom: CH4 purity swinging 93–97% every few minutes
Root Cause: Recycle valve positioner hunting on wet instrument air
Why Chain: Why swings? Recycle valve hunting > Why? Positioner fed wet air > Why wet? Instrument air dryer desiccant spent
Resolution: Drained air headers, replaced desiccant, recalibrated positioner
Preventive Action: Monthly instrument-air dew point check; quarterly valve stroke test

Symptom: dP steadily climbing from 0.05 to 0.13 bar over a week
Root Cause: Top media layer caked by free water and elemental sulfur
Why Chain: Why dP climbing? Top 150 mm caked > Why caked? Free water reached the bed > Why water? Knock-out pot auto-drain blocked > Why unnoticed? Pot not on shift rounds
Resolution: N2 back-flush per SOP-SCR-02, replaced caked layer (kept wet), cleaned knock-out auto-drain
Preventive Action: Auto-drain with level alarm on knock-out pot; added to shift rounds

Symptom: Gas outlet drifted to 9 °C over a week; CHL-01 engaged
Root Cause: Refrigerant leak at a vibrating flare joint
Why Chain: Why warm? Low charge, bubbles in sight glass > Why low? Flare joint leaking > Why? Line unsupported and fatigued by vibration
Resolution: Leak-tested, re-made joint, clamped line, recharged; released CHL-01 at 3.5 °C
Preventive Action: Clamp refrigerant lines; quarterly leak test; trend suction pressure

Symptom: Hot spot 70 °C on shell; outlet O2 1.4%
Root Cause: Air dosing rotameter opened too far
Why Chain: Why hot spot? Exothermic reaction with excess O2 > Why excess O2? Rotameter opened to stretch media life > Why? No written dosing range
Resolution: Stopped air dosing, kept gas flowing until shell cooled, reset to 0.4% O2 outlet
Preventive Action: Dosing range in SOP-BUU-01; high outlet O2 alarm; operator training

Symptom: Purity slowly falling to 94%; permeate dP 40% above baseline
Root Cause: Fibres fouled by compressor oil after guard bed exhaustion
Why Chain: Why falling purity? Fibres coated > Why coated? Oil / VOC passed the guard bed > Why? Carbon exhausted, change on calendar with no breakthrough check
Resolution: Replaced activated-carbon guard bed, overhauled LP compressor oil separator, OEM performance test
Preventive Action: Quarterly VOC check after guard bed; weekly coalescer oil log

Symptom: Filter dP rose to 0.36 bar then fell to near zero; particles at compressor strainer
Root Cause: Element collapsed after change-out was deferred
Why Chain: Why dP collapse? Element pleats split > Why? dP above 0.30 bar limit > Why not changed? No spare elements in stock
Resolution: Tripped LP load line (CMP-01), replaced element and O-ring, cleaned suction strainers
Preventive Action: Two spare element sets in stock; high and high-high dP alarms

Symptom: Filter dP high with water in housing during monsoon
Root Cause: Condensate from cooling gas line soaked elements
Why Chain: Why high dP? Elements wet and swollen > Why wet? Water condensed in the gas line > Why? Line uninsulated, no drain point before skid
Resolution: Drained housing, replaced wet elements, cleaned drain trap, added low-point drain pot
Preventive Action: Insulate line; low-point drain pot; monsoon drain checks

Symptom: dP sudden drop and media granules at filter skid
Root Cause: Top distributor mesh perimeter seal gap causing channeling
Why Chain: Why dP drop? Gas channeled along the wall > Why? Perimeter seal gap at the mesh > Why? Mesh refitted without torque or contact check > Why? SOP had no acceptance step
Resolution: Locked bypass (SCR-01), re-seated media, new perimeter seal, torqued 25 N·m, flushed skid
Preventive Action: Signed mesh-contact and torque check added to SOP-SCR-02

Symptom: Methane purity dropped to 92%; MEM-01 diverted to flare
Root Cause: Water carryover from chiller auto-drain failure
Why Chain: Why purity drop? Liquid water in membrane fibres > Why? Chiller separator flooded > Why? Auto-drain trap blocked with sludge > Why unnoticed? No strainer and no drain-cycle alarm
Resolution: Repaired auto-drain, dried membranes per OEM, verified purity above 95%
Preventive Action: Y-strainer before trap; SCADA alarm on drain cycles below 2/h

Symptom: MEM-01 tripped at 94%; portable analyser read 96.5%
Why Chain: Why trip? Analyser read low > Why? Drift since last calibration 4 months ago > Why? Analyser not on calibration schedule
Resolution: Calibrated analyser with certified gas, changed sample filter, released MEM-01
Preventive Action: Weekly zero/span; monthly calibration in PM
